hourly_target: next local day, 24 separate hourly mean-power forecasts at midnight
monthly_target: average kW in each of next three calendar months from start-of-month origin
peak_rule: hourly mean kW strictly above per-building development 90th percentile
season_note: explicit month-based groups; no observed weather or supplied season labels
test: 2017, reserved by timestamp/target completion; all buildings share dates
folds: 2015, 2016 H1, 2016 H2; expanding training; monthly training labels must finish before origin
selection: minimum mean macro-building WAPE across chronological development folds
known_inputs: past power and future calendar only; no future activity label, future measurements, weather or measured target-day summaries
deployment: evaluation artifacts frozen; separate operational refits use data through 2017 and issue January 2018 forecasts
